dwelling_habits.dwelling: Reef flats and lagoons; jointed green coin-like segments.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Makes energy from sunlight (and sometimes from clear shallow water light).
dwelling_habits.mating: Spreads by spores, seeds, propagules, or creeping rhizomes depending on the species.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Forms habitat structure that shelters fish, crabs, and invertebrates.

fun_facts: Calcified segments break down into tropical white sand.

dwelling_habits.dwelling: Coral reefs rich in sponges; nests on tropical beaches.
dwelling_habits.food: Sponges — one of the few animals that dine on them.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Narrow beak reaches into reef cracks for sponge bites.
dwelling_habits.mating: Females nest on beaches; hatchlings race to the sea.

fun_facts: Named for a hawk-like beak perfect for sponge surgery.
Critically endangered — shell trade and habitat loss hit them hard.
